title: qwirq.yaml
description: QWIRQ project manifest: how a project presents and runs on QWIRQ. The build pipeline (P0-c) parses this into a registry AppManifest + runner entries; VS Code validates against it (DX-5). See DEV-EXPERIENCE-PLAN.md sections 3 and 6.

id.description: Stable app id within the instance (kebab-case). Becomes AppManifest.id / instance_apps.app_id. WARNING: changing this value on a git push registers a NEW app at the new id and leaves the old registration intact — the old URL (/a/<old-id>) stays live and stale. To rename cleanly, either add renamedFrom: <old-id> to this manifest (one push, then remove it) or run `qwirq app rename <old-id> <new-id>` / `qwirq app rm <old-id>` to clean up the orphan.

renamedFrom.description: One-time migration hint: the old app id this project was previously registered under. On the first push after adding this field the deploy pipeline removes the stale old-id registration and registers under the current id in one atomic operation. Remove this field after the first successful push.

icon.description: Icon key the shell maps to an icon component. Use a built-in key from @qwirq/ui-icon-kit or define a custom icon under custom_icons. Unknown keys fall back to the folder icon (warning emitted, not an error).

custom_icons.description: Custom icons for this app registered into the shell icon registry. Each entry supplies a key (used in the icon field or via the registry) and raw SVG inner markup.

key.description: Registry key for this icon, e.g. my_logo.

svg.description: Raw SVG inner markup (paths, circles, etc.) inserted into a 24x24 viewBox shell.

nav.description: Where the app mounts in the shell nav. Omit to use defaults.

hidden.description: Registered + mountable but not shown in the sidebar (AppManifest.nav=false).

requires.description: PDP gate (AppManifest.requires); omitted = always visible. Evaluated server-side per user.

provides.description: The capabilities this project provides (at least one). A project can provide several. Optional only when pipeline.checks is present (a pipeline-only project is not an app and is never registered into an instance).

app.description: A UI surface mounted in the shell. React, built against the instance-pinned React (Module Federation remote).

entry.description: Path to the app entry module, e.g. src/app/index.tsx.

functions.description: Server functions: backend logic run in the in-instance runner, served at POST /api/apps/{id}/fn/{name} (contract v1; see the 'Server functions' article in the knowledge base).

name.description: Stable function identifier within the app; part of the invocation URL.

entry.description: Path to the handler module (default-exports async (ctx, input) => json).

http.description: Reserved: REST-style alias, e.g. 'POST /assign'. Accepted now; alias routing is a fast-follow. The canonical /fn/{name} route always works.

tool.description: Declare this function as a Mabel tool (F-010). Calls arrive as actor 'mabel' on behalf of an authenticated user; authorization evaluates as that user. Declaration is v1-stable; Mabel execution is a fast-follow.

description.description: What the tool does, written for the assistant.

parameters.description: JSON Schema for the tool's input (also documents the function's input shape).

secrets.description: Vault secret NAMES this function may read at runtime via ctx.secrets.get(name). Declared-only: the function reads exactly these, resolved AS THE INVOKING USER (only the user's own grants apply — never blanket vault access). An undeclared name throws before any DB call. Omit = the function reads no secrets.

jobs.description: Scheduled or triggered runs (the runner model).

schedule.description: Cron expression for scheduled runs, e.g. '0 2 * * *'.

components.description: Catalog component IDs this project installs beyond the free baseline @qwirq/blocks (e.g. 'acme/data-grid'). The deploy pipeline checks entitlements for each listed component; unlicensed entries block the deploy. Omit to use the baseline kit only.

migrations.description: Path to the migrations directory (fed to `qwirq data migrate`).

runtime.description: Backend runtime host. 'node20' = in-process Node (P0 default); 'python312' = CPython subprocess (DX-8, gated on DX-4+DX-2); 'rust' = native binary compiled at build time (DX-8). UI is always React/TS regardless of runtime.

platform.description: The instance platform release this builds against (pins React + the SDK), e.g. '2026.06'.

pipeline.description: Checks run on every push against the exact pushed commit, and the build targets they gate. Unsupported fields are rejected, never ignored.

targetRef.description: The integration branch. A push to it is a 'push' event; a push to any other branch is evaluated as a 'pull_request' against its merge-base with this ref. Must be a well-formed refs/heads/<name> (the git-host intake grammar).

builds.description: Build targets (M2: android-apk; M3: expo-update). A build runs on request against a commit whose required checks pass; it is not a check.

checks.description: The commit's checks (at most 50). Names are unique; needs form an acyclic graph.

name.description: Check name, unique within the manifest; referenced by needs.

adapter.description: How the check runs. 'command' = ordered argv steps in a container.

required.description: Whether the check gates the commit's status.

image.x-patternMessage: is not digest-pinned: use name[:tag]@sha256:<64 lowercase hex>
image.description: Immutable image reference: name[:tag]@sha256:<64 lowercase hex>. A tag alone is rejected; resolve it to its digest.

labels.description: Worker labels this check needs, e.g. [linux, docker]. A worker must carry all of them.

needs.description: Checks in this manifest that must succeed first. A failed dependency skips this check. Naming a matrix check means every one of its expanded jobs.

failFast.description: Matrix checks only: when one expanded job fails, cancel its unfinished siblings. false = every expanded job runs to its own result.

env.description: Literal environment values for every step of this check. A step's own env overrides a key set here; platform-injected variables (proxy settings on dependencies steps) override both. Never put secrets here; the manifest is committed.

steps.description: Ordered steps (at most 32); the check stops at the first failing step.

name.description: Step name, unique within the check.

run.description: argv, e.g. [node, test.mjs]. No implicit shell; write [sh, -c, '...'] when you want one.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the repository root; must stay inside it.

env.description: Literal environment values for this step; a key here overrides the check's env. Never put secrets here; the manifest is committed.

outputs.description: Files kept after the check runs (test reports, logs).

name.description: Output name, unique within the check.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root; must stay inside it.

when.description: Keep the file always, only on success, or only on failure.

releases.description: Release channels this repository wants. DESIRED configuration only: the owner reconciles it through revisioned settings. A push cannot set a signing identity, grant secrets, enable public access, publish, or unpause an owner-paused channel.

propertyNames.x-patternMessage: is not a valid environment variable name

pipelineEnv.description: Literal environment values. Never put secrets here; the manifest is committed.

pipelineNetwork.description: Network profile for the step. none = no network at all; services = only this job attempt's own services; dependencies = its services plus the platform's reviewed package-registry proxy (the allowlist is platform policy; a manifest cannot add hosts).

propertyNames.x-patternMessage: is not a service name: lowercase DNS label, at most 32 characters

pipelineServices.description: Disposable service containers (databases, object-store mocks) on a private per-attempt network; each is reachable from steps on the services or dependencies network at its name, e.g. postgres:5432. Never published on the host.

env.description: Literal, disposable test values for the service container.

ready.description: Readiness probe run inside the service until it exits 0. Steps start only after every service is ready; exhausting the attempts fails the job as service_unhealthy.

command.description: argv inside the service container, e.g. [pg_isready, -U, postgres].

limits.description: Service container limits; omitted values take the defaults.

pipelineCaches.description: Package-download caches. Restored into an attempt-local copy, saved only after success, keyed by the exact content of the input files (plus tenant, repository, trust lane, image and platform policy). Never cache node_modules, build outputs or credentials.

name.description: Cache name, unique within the check.

path.x-patternMessage: must be an absolute path under /cache/ (lowercase segments, no . or .. segments)
path.description: Mount point inside the job container, under /cache/, e.g. /cache/pnpm.

inputs.description: Exact repository files whose content keys the cache (lockfiles, workspace config, patches). No globs.

pipelineReports.description: Files or directories archived after the steps run (including on failure), stored privately with the attempt.

name.description: Report name, unique among this check's outputs and reports.

paths.description: Files or directories relative to the repository root.

retentionDays.description: Requested retention; the operator ceiling applies.

propertyNames.x-patternMessage: is not a matrix axis name: lowercase letter, then letters, digits or _, at most 16

pipelineMatrix.description: Scalar axes expanded into one job per combination (at most 50 jobs per push in total). Each job is named <check>-<axis>-<value>[-<axis>-<value>...] with axes in name order, e.g. e2e-shard-1. ${matrix.<axis>} is replaced in step run arguments and env values only; nothing is evaluated.

anyOf.x-patternMessage: must be lowercase letters, digits, ., _ or - and start with a letter or digit

pipelineTrigger.description: When the check applies. An inapplicable check records its reason and is not a success. When changed paths cannot be computed the check runs.

events.description: push = a push to targetRef; pull_request = a push to any other branch (until changes land, against its merge-base with targetRef); manual = an explicit run. Default: all.

paths.description: Applies only when a changed file matches one of these globs.

pathGlob.x-patternMessage: must be a relative glob inside the repository: * and ? within a segment, ** as a whole segment; no [ ] { } ! or backslash
pathGlob.description: Relative POSIX glob: '*' matches within a path segment, '?' one character, '**' as a whole segment any number of segments.

pipelineBuild.description: A build target. android-apk: an unsigned release APK from an Expo project, signed afterwards by the platform signer. expo-update (M3): an over-the-air content export sharing an android-apk target's native identity. The toolchain image, resource limits, signing and allocated version code are platform-owned.

name.description: Build target name, unique within the manifest (qwirq build --target <name>).

native.description: expo-update only: the android-apk target whose app, install, prepare, inputs and env this export shares.

applicationId.x-patternMessage: is not an Android application id (e.g. com.example.app)
applicationId.description: Android package; version codes are allocated per tenant + application id.

install.description: android-apk only: locked dependency installs, in order, each from its own committed lockfile (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile / npm ci).

path.description: Directory holding the package.json and lockfile. Default: the repository root.

items.x-patternMessage: is not a workspace package name

filter.description: pnpm only: install just these workspace packages (--filter).

prepare.description: android-apk only: argv steps after install and before the clean native prebuild (e.g. build shared workspace packages). No network.

inputs.description: android-apk only: public build inputs placed at path before prebuild (e.g. google-services.json). Supplied by the owner-configured input of the same name when not in the repository; the digest is recorded with the build. Never credentials.

sha256.description: Optional pin; a different file fails the build.

downloads.description: android-apk only: checksum-pinned files fetched through the dependency proxy (never by a package's own unchecked script), verified, and placed after install and after the runtime fingerprint is computed. unpack: zip extracts into path. The host must be on the reviewed dependency allowlist.

url.x-patternMessage: must be an https URL on a named host (no credentials, port, query or fragment)

path.description: Destination file, or directory when unpack is zip.

runtime.description: android-apk only: fingerprint = runtime from the validated Expo fingerprint + native-tree digest (opaque when validation fails); opaque = always a build-unique runtime (no content updates).

env.description: android-apk only: literal, non-secret build environment.

name.description: Channel name, unique per platform, e.g. internal, production.

build.description: The android-apk build target whose signed APKs this channel publishes.

content.description: M3: the expo-update target whose content this channel publishes; its native target must be build.

default.description: The channel /get/<project> resolves to. At most one per platform.

autoPublish.description: Desire: publish verified main builds automatically. Takes effect only through an owner-enabled rule; never unpauses an owner pause.

audience.description: Desire: who may install. members = signed-in repository readers; key = also holders of the channel key. Public access is not configurable from source.

sha256.x-patternMessage: is not a lowercase hex SHA-256

jobPlan.description: Engine contract: one normalized job (an M0 check, or one expanded matrix job) as planPipeline emits it and the pipeline engine admits it (normalizeJobPlans). Not authored in qwirq.yaml.

needs.description: Exact job names in the same submission.

matrix.description: Display/grouping metadata of an expanded matrix job. name must equal the canonical expansion name of group + values.

pipelineName.x-patternMessage: must be lowercase letters, digits, ., _ or - and start with a letter or digit
pipelineName.description: Lowercase name: letters, digits, '.', '_', '-'; starts with a letter or digit.

relativePath.x-patternMessage: must be a relative path inside the repository (no leading /, no .. segment, no backslash or drive letter)
relativePath.description: Relative POSIX path inside the repository: no leading '/', no '..' segment, no backslash or drive letter.

pipelineLimits.description: Per-check resource limits. Omitted values take the defaults; worker policy can lower them.

seconds.description: Timeout for the whole check, in seconds.
